Method of Attack: Exploits severe vulnerabilities in PaperCut MF/NG to install remote management software (Atera, Syncro) and execute arbitrary code with SYSTEM privileges
Executes PowerShell commands to install remote management software
Used as a downloader to deploy Clop ransomware payloads
Attack Vector: Remote code execution via authentication bypass exploiting CVE-2023-27350 and CVE-2023-27351
Abuse of built-in 'Scripting' functionality for printers
Remote exploitation of internet-exposed PaperCut servers on default web management port 9191
Indicators of Compromise: windowservicecenter[.]com domain used to host and deliver TrueBot downloader
PowerShell commands installing Atera and Syncro remote management software
Internet-exposed PaperCut servers (~1,700 identified via Shodan)
